title: Berries on Toast Recipe
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 tbsp of icing sugar, for dusting
ldInstructionsRaw: Whisk the cream, eggs, egg yolks, sugar and cinnamon together in a bowl. Remove the crusts from the bread then dip the slices into the cream mixture
Heat the butter in a frying pan and when bubbling, fry the bread until golden on each side. Drain on kitchen paper and sprinkle over the icing sugar
Stir together the wimberries and jam and spoon over the toast. Serve immediately
